title: Extinct: the Giant Deer
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.prompt: “The remains of the Irish elk were first found in Europe and Central Asia approximately 28______.”
questions.translation: Irish elk 的遺骸／物種最早大約在 ______ 出現在 Europe and Central Asia。

blocks.text: “The Irish elk, so-called because its well-preserved remains are often found in lake sediments under peat bogs in Ireland, first appeared about 400,000 years ago in Europe and Central Asia.”
Irish elk 之所以這樣命名，是因為牠保存良好的遺骸常在 Ireland 泥炭沼澤下的湖泊沉積物中被發現；牠約 400,000 年前首次出現在 Europe and Central Asia。
“The deer’s range later contracted to the Ural Mountains, in modern-day Russia, which separate Europe from Asia.”
這種鹿後來的分布範圍縮小到現代 Russia 的 Ural Mountains；這些山脈分隔 Europe 和 Asia。
只看首尾句，可以先知道 Paragraph B 在交代 Irish elk 的出現時間和分布變化。題目出現Europe and Central Asia，正好是第一句的原字，因此目標段落很清楚。
題目中最有定位力的字是：
原文中最直接的對應是：
“first appeared about 400,000 years ago in Europe and Central Asia”
這裡題目把 “about” 改成 “approximately”。題目寫 “remains … were first found” 有一點不精準，因為原文真正說的是 Irish elk 這個物種 “first appeared”。不過 summary 明顯要我們取時間。
“The Irish elk … first appeared about 400,000 years ago in Europe and Central Asia.”
Irish elk 約 400,000 年前首次出現在 Europe and Central Asia。
題目空格前已有 “approximately”，所以答案不需要再填 about。字數限制是 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS，因此：
剛好三個詞／數字單位，形式正確。
題目 “approximately”= 原文 “about”題目 “first found in Europe and Central Asia”≈ 原文 “first appeared … in Europe and Central Asia”所以 28 答案是 400,000 years ago。

questions.prompt: “Around 29 ______, they were driven onto the plains after their range contracted to the Ural Mountains.”
questions.translation: 大約在 ______，牠們的活動範圍縮小到 Ural Mountains 後，被推向 plains。

blocks.text: “The giant deer made its last stand in western Siberia, some 3,000 years after the ice sheets receded, said the study’s co-author, Adrian Lister, professor of palaeobiology at University College London, England.”
研究共同作者、University College London 的 palaeobiology 教授 Adrian Lister 說，giant deer 在ice sheets 退去約 3,000 年後，於 western Siberia 作最後生存。
“‘In combination with human pressures, this could have finally snuffed them out,’ Lister said.”
Lister 說：「再加上人類壓力，這可能最終把牠們消滅。」只看首尾句，Paragraph C 會講 giant deer 最後階段的地理位置和滅絕壓力。題目提到 plains 和Ural Mountains，正好是 C 段中間關於 Urals 森林化的細節。
“the eastern foothills of the Urals became very densely forested about 8,000 years ago”
“could have pushed them on to the plain”
“pushed them on to the plain” 和題目 “driven onto the plains” 是非常接近的改寫。
原文關鍵句：“The eastern foothills of the Urals became very densely forested about 8,000 years ago, which could have pushed them on to the plain,” he said.

他說，Ural Mountains 東部山麓約 8,000 年前變得森林非常密集，這可能把牠們推到平原上。題目中的 “were driven onto the plains” 對應原文 “could have pushed them on to the plain”。題目中的 “Around” 對應原文 “about”。答案不能填 “about 8,000 years ago”，因為 about 加起來會超過三個詞，而且題目已有 Around。最合適答案是： 8,000 years ago所以 29 答案是 8,000 years ago。

questions.prompt: “Hunting was considered an important factor in the Irish elk’s extinction, but humans did not begin hunting them until 30 ______; the animals had previously survived a variety of climatic fluctuations.”
questions.translation: Hunting 曾被視為 Irish elk 滅絕的重要因素，但人類直到 ______ 才開始狩獵牠們；這些動物此前已經撐過多次氣候波動。

blocks.text: “Hunting by humans has often been put forward as a contributory cause of extinction of the Pleistocene megafauna.”
人類狩獵經常被提出，作為 Pleistocene megafauna 滅絕的一個促成原因。
“The presence of humans may help explain why the Irish elk was unable to tough out the latest of many climatic fluctuations – periods it had survived in the past.”
人類的存在也許有助解釋為何 Irish elk 無法撐過最新一輪氣候波動；過去牠曾經熬過很多這類時期。
首尾句都與題目高度吻合：hunting by humans、climatic fluctuations、survived in the past 都出現了。因此 Paragraph D 是目標段落。
“We haven’t got just hunting 7,000 years ago”
“first Neolithic people settled in the region”
“periods it had survived in the past”
最強數字定位詞是 “7,000 years ago”。
“Lister said, ‘We haven’t got just hunting 7,000 years ago – this was also about the time the first Neolithic people settled in the region. They were farmers who would have cleared the land.’”

Lister 說：「我們面對的並非只有 7,000 年前的狩獵；那也大約是第一批 Neolithic people 在該地區定居的時候。他們是農民，會清理土地。」這題的題目句有一個小問題：原文沒有明確說 “humans did not begin hunting them until 7,000 years ago”。原文較準確的意思是：7,000 年前有 hunting 這個因素，同時也有 Neolithic farmers settlement and land clearing。題目把這個意思壓縮成 “did not begin hunting … until”，略為過度簡化。
不過按 summary 的空格位置和原文唯一相關時間，答案仍是： 7,000 years ago

題目 “Hunting was considered an important factor”= 原文 “Hunting by humans has often been put forward as a contributory cause”題目 “previously survived climatic fluctuations”= 原文 “periods it had survived in the past”所以 30 答案是 7,000 years ago，但要留意題目 wording 沒有完全保留原文的精確語氣。

questions.prompt: “The huge antlers may also have contributed to their extinction, although this is controversial because they survived well through 31 ______.”
questions.translation: 巨大鹿角也可能促成牠們滅絕，但這一點有爭議，因為牠們曾順利撐過 ______。

blocks.text: “Meanwhile, Lister cast doubt on another possible explanation for the deer’s demise – the male’s huge antlers.”
同時，Lister 質疑另一個可能解釋 deer 滅亡的說法，也就是雄鹿的 huge antlers。

“When the climate changed at the end of the last glacial period, the vegetation in the animal’s habitat also changed to species that presumably could not provide sufficient amounts of the required minerals, at least in the western part of its range.”
當 last glacial period 結束時氣候改變，牠棲息地的植被也變成了某些可能無法提供足夠所需minerals 的物種，至少在牠分布範圍的西部如此。
只看首尾句，可以知道 Paragraph E 集中處理 antlers theory 及其問題。題目說 huge antlers，目標段落自然是 E。
“the deer previously survived perfectly well through wooded interglacials”
“survived perfectly well through” 和題目 “survived well through” 幾乎直接對應。
原文關鍵句：“But, Lister said, ‘That’s a hard argument to make because the deer previously survived perfectly well through wooded interglacials [warmer periods between ice ages].’”

但是 Lister 說：「這個論點很難成立，因為這種鹿以前曾經非常順利地撐過 wooded interglacials，即 ice ages 之間較暖的、有林地的間冰期。」題目說 “this is controversial because they survived well through…”原文說 “a hard argument to make because the deer previously survived perfectly well through…”答案應直接取原文短語： wooded interglacials不要填 “warmer periods between ice ages”，雖然括號有解釋，但題目要求 from passage，且
“wooded interglacials” 是原文主詞組，也更貼近 “survived well through”。所以 31 答案是 wooded interglacials。

questions.prompt: “It is generally believed that, by the end of the last ice age, many large mammals had become extinct about 32 ______.”
questions.translation: 一般認為，到 last ice age 結束時，很多大型 mammals 大約在 ______ 滅絕。

blocks.text: 目標位置：Opening paragraph原文句子：
“Saber-toothed cats, mastodons, giant sloths, woolly rhinos, and many other large, shaggy mammals are widely thought to have died out around the end of the last ice age, some 10,500 years ago.”
Saber-toothed cats、mastodons、giant sloths、woolly rhinos，以及許多其他大型多毛 mammals，一般被認為在 last ice age 結束時滅絕，即大約 10,500 年前。
這個 opening paragraph 只有一個句子，因此首句和尾句相同。它提供全篇背景，也直接給出many large mammals 和 10,500 years ago。
“around the end of the last ice age”
這是典型 summary 同義改寫題。
“around the end of the last ice age, some 10,500 years ago”
大約在 last ice age 結束時，即約 10,500 年前。
題目中的 “generally believed” 對應 “widely thought”。
題目中的 “become extinct” 對應 “died out”。
答案是： 10,500 years ago符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
所以 32 答案是 10,500 years ago。

questions.prompt: “Which physical characteristic may have contributed to the extinction of the Irish elk?”
questions.translation: Irish elk 的哪一項 physical characteristic 可能促成牠滅絕？

blocks.text: “Meanwhile, Lister cast doubt on another possible explanation for the deer’s demise – the male’s huge antlers.”
同時，Lister 質疑另一個可能解釋 deer 滅亡的說法，也就是雄鹿的 huge antlers。

“When the climate changed at the end of the last glacial period, the vegetation in the animal’s habitat also changed to species that presumably could not provide sufficient amounts of the required minerals, at least in the western part of its range.”
當 last glacial period 結束時氣候改變，牠棲息地的 vegetation 也改變成可能無法提供足夠所需minerals 的物種，至少在其西部分布範圍如此。
只看首尾句，Paragraph E 是 antlers theory 的集中段。題目問 physical characteristic，第一句就直接出現 huge antlers。
“another possible explanation for the deer’s demise”
“demise / downfall” 都是 extinction 的近義方向。

原文關鍵句：“Some scientists have suggested this exaggerated feature – the result of females preferring stags with the largest antlers, possibly because they advertised a male’s fitness – contributed to the mammal’s downfall.”
一些科學家提出，這項誇張特徵可能促成這種 mammal 的滅亡；這特徵源於雌鹿偏好鹿角最大的雄鹿，可能因為鹿角展示了雄鹿的健康或適應能力。
這裡 “this exaggerated feature” 指前一句的 “the male’s huge antlers”。題目問 physical characteristic，所以答案要填特徵本身，而非整句原因。
“male’s huge antlers” 也在三詞限制內，但 short-answer 通常填核心名詞短語即可。所以 33 答案是 huge antlers。

questions.prompt: “Which nutrients were needed to maintain the Irish elk’s huge antlers?”
questions.translation: 哪些 nutrients 是維持 Irish elk 巨大鹿角所需的？

blocks.text: “Meanwhile, Lister cast doubt on another possible explanation for the deer’s demise – the male’s huge antlers.”
同時，Lister 質疑另一個可能解釋 deer 滅亡的說法，也就是雄鹿的 huge antlers。

“When the climate changed at the end of the last glacial period, the vegetation in the animal’s habitat also changed to species that presumably could not provide sufficient amounts of the required minerals, at least in the western part of its range.”
當 last glacial period 結束時，牠棲息地的 vegetation 也改變成可能無法提供足夠 required minerals 的物種，至少在牠分布範圍的西部如此。
題目問 nutrients / minerals，E 段最後一句已有 required minerals，目標段落明確。
“High amounts of calcium and phosphate compounds are required to form antlers”
“large quantities of these minerals are required”
原文關鍵句：“High amounts of calcium and phosphate compounds are required to form antlers, and therefore large quantities of these minerals are required for the massive structures of the Irish elk.”
形成鹿角需要大量 calcium and phosphate compounds，因此 Irish elk 的巨大結構需要大量這些minerals。

這題有一個答案形式問題：原文完整短語是 “calcium and phosphate compounds”，但這是四個詞，超過題目限制 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER。由於題目問 “Which nutrients”，核心營養／礦物名稱是 calcium 和 phosphate，因此最合適的三詞答案是： calcium and phosphate如果填 “calcium and phosphate compounds”，內容最完整，但字數不合規。IELTS 實戰中要優先遵守字數限制。
所以 34 答案是 calcium and phosphate。

questions.prompt: “Evidence from which region suggested that human arrival contributed to megafaunal extinction?”
questions.translation: 哪個地區的 evidence 顯示 human arrival 可能促成 megafaunal extinction？

blocks.text: “The group of scientists led by A. J. Stuart focused on northern Eurasia—essentially Europe and Siberia—where the best data show that animals became extinct during the Late Pleistocene.”
A. J. Stuart 領導的科學家團隊聚焦 northern Eurasia，也就是 Europe and Siberia；那裡最佳數據顯示動物在 Late Pleistocene 期間滅絕。
“Extinction followed human predation, but only during periods of fundamental environmental change.”
滅絕跟隨人類捕食出現，但只在根本性環境變化時期發生。
只看首尾句，Paragraph G 會談 Stuart team 的研究結論：human predation 和 environmental change 的關係。題目問 human arrival contributed，應看 G 段中關於人類到達時間和 extinction pattern 的比較。
原文中最重要的句子是：
“these patterns relate to differences in the timing of human arrival”
這句前面提到兩個地區的對比：
“northern Eurasia were moderate and staggered, whereas those in North America were severe and sudden”

“The data also reveal a profound contrast: extinctions in northern Eurasia were moderate and staggered, whereas those in North America were severe and sudden. These patterns relate to differences in the timing of human arrival.”
數據也揭示了一個深刻對比：northern Eurasia 的滅絕是 moderate and staggered，而 North America 的滅絕則 severe and sudden。這些模式與 human arrival 的時間差異有關。

題目問 “from which region”。雖然 Stuart team 主要研究 northern Eurasia，但 “human arrival contributed” 這個概念在這裡是透過 North America 的 severe and sudden extinctions 對比出來的。North America 的模式更明顯地連到 human arrival 的 timing。
題目 “human arrival contributed”= 原文 “patterns relate to differences in the timing of human arrival”題目 “megafaunal extinction”= 原文 “extinctions … severe and sudden”所以 35 答案是 North America。

questions.prompt: the region where humans had little impact on megafaunal extinction
questions.translation: 人類對 megafaunal extinction 影響較小的地區。

blocks.text: “The extinction of megafauna around the world was almost completed by the end of the last ice age.”
世界各地 megafauna 的滅絕，到 last ice age 結束時幾乎已完成。
“Regularly hunted modern kangaroos survived not only 10,000 years of Aboriginal hunting, but also an onslaught of commercial shooters.”
經常被狩獵的現代 kangaroos 不但撐過了 10,000 年 Aboriginal hunting，也撐過了 commercial shooters 的猛烈獵殺。
只看首尾句，可以看出 Paragraph F 是全球地區比較，尤其尾句用 Australia 的 kangaroos 說明hunting 不一定會導致大型動物滅絕。題目問 humans had little impact，這段的 Australia 例子最直接。
“people have been in Australia for up to 60,000 years”
“megafauna must have co-existed with humans for at least 30,000 years”
這些句子都在削弱「人類一到就造成滅絕」的說法。
“If people have been in Australia for up to 60,000 years, then megafauna must have co-existed with humans for at least 30,000 years.”
如果人類在 Australia 已經生活了最多 60,000 年，那麼 megafauna 必定至少和人類共存了30,000 年。
“Regularly hunted modern kangaroos survived not only 10,000 years of Aboriginal hunting, but also an onslaught of commercial shooters.”
經常被狩獵的現代 kangaroos 不但撐過了 10,000 年 Aboriginal hunting，也撐過了 commercial shooters 的猛烈獵殺。
這兩句合起來表示：在 Australia，人類存在和狩獵本身不足以解釋 megafaunal extinction。動物與人類共存了很長時間，且 kangaroos 這個被狩獵例子仍能存活。題目中的 “humans had little impact” 正是對這組證據的概括。
所以 36 答案是 B — Australia。
補充說明：如果你的教材要求四個地區各用一次，可能會把 Q36 放到 Africa，因為 Africa
“escaped major faunal extinction”。可是直接談人類共存和 hunting impact 的證據，在 Australia句組更清楚。

questions.prompt: the region where climate change was mild and the fauna survived
questions.translation: 氣候變化較溫和，而且 fauna 得以存活的地區。

blocks.text: “The extinction of megafauna around the world was almost completed by the end of the last ice age.”
世界各地 megafauna 的滅絕，到 last ice age 結束時幾乎已完成。
“Regularly hunted modern kangaroos survived not only 10,000 years of Aboriginal hunting, but also an onslaught of commercial shooters.”
經常被狩獵的現代 kangaroos 不但撐過了 10,000 年 Aboriginal hunting，也撐過了 commercial shooters 的猛烈獵殺。
Paragraph F 進行全球比較。題目問 climate change mild 和 fauna survived，應掃描 Africa / Asia相關句子。
“Tropical and subtropical areas have experienced less radical climatic change.”
“Africa escaped major faunal extinction as did tropical and sub-tropical Asia.”
“less radical climatic change” 對應 “climate change was mild”。“escaped major faunal extinction” 對應 “fauna survived”。
原文關鍵句：“Tropical and subtropical areas have experienced less radical climatic change.”
熱帶和亞熱帶地區經歷的氣候變化較不劇烈。
“Significantly, Africa escaped major faunal extinction as did tropical and sub-tropical Asia.”
值得注意的是，Africa 避免了大型 fauna 滅絕；tropical and sub-tropical Asia 也一樣。

這題在文字上略有模糊，因為 Africa 和 tropical / sub-tropical Asia 都被說成 escaped major faunal extinction。若要把 “climate change was mild” 和地區名稱最緊密配對，C — Asia 比較安全，因為原文明確限定 “tropical and sub-tropical Asia”，與前一句 “Tropical and subtropical areas” 直接相連。
所以 37 答案是 C — Asia。

questions.prompt: the region where both humans and climate change contributed to extinction
questions.translation: 人類和 climate change 共同促成 extinction 的地區。

blocks.text: “The group of scientists led by A. J. Stuart focused on northern Eurasia—essentially Europe and Siberia—where the best data show that animals became extinct during the Late Pleistocene.”
A. J. Stuart 領導的科學家團隊聚焦 northern Eurasia，也就是 Europe and Siberia；那裡最佳數據顯示動物在 Late Pleistocene 期間滅絕。
“Extinction followed human predation, but only during periods of fundamental environmental change.”
滅絕跟隨人類捕食出現，但只在根本性環境變化時期發生。
只看首尾句，這段焦點是 northern Eurasia 的 extinction pattern，並且把 human predation 和environmental change 放在一起。
“together with the presence of advanced Palaeolithic humans”
這一句明確有 together with，是本題最強證據。

“Instead, the evidence points to a combined effect: a fundamental change in climate reorganised the vegetation, and this change, together with the presence of advanced Palaeolithic humans, caused the wave of extinction.”
相反，證據指向一種 combined effect：根本性的氣候變化重組了植被，而這種變化，加上advanced Palaeolithic humans 的存在，造成了這波滅絕。
這句的主體是 Paragraph G 開頭的 northern Eurasia。

“combined effect” 直接表示兩種因素共同作用。“fundamental change in climate” 對應 climate change。“presence of advanced Palaeolithic humans” 對應 humans。“caused the wave of extinction” 對應 contributed to extinction。所以 38 答案是 A — Eurasia。

questions.prompt: the region where climate change alone caused a major extinction
questions.translation: 主要由 climate change 造成大型滅絕的地區。

blocks.text: “The extinction of megafauna around the world was almost completed by the end of the last ice age.”
世界各地 megafauna 的滅絕，到 last ice age 結束時幾乎已完成。
“Regularly hunted modern kangaroos survived not only 10,000 years of Aboriginal hunting, but also an onslaught of commercial shooters.”
經常被狩獵的現代 kangaroos 不但撐過了 10,000 年 Aboriginal hunting，也撐過了 commercial shooters 的猛烈獵殺。
Paragraph F 中段詳述 Australia climate change：從 cold-dry 變成 warm-dry，surface water scarce，large browsing animals lost habitat。這正是題目 “climate change alone” 的主要來源。
“Australia’s climate changed from cold-dry to warm-dry.”
“As a result, surface water became scarce.”
“Most large, predominantly browsing animals lost their habitat.”
“co-existed with humans for at least 30,000 years”
題目中的 “alone” 不是原文原字，但由後文長期 human co-existence 和 kangaroo hunting survival 推出：人類狩獵很難單獨解釋這次滅絕。
“Australia’s climate changed from cold-dry to warm-dry. As a result, surface water became scarce.”
Australia 的氣候從 cold-dry 變成 warm-dry。結果，地表水變得稀少。
“Most large, predominantly browsing animals lost their habitat and retreated to a narrow band in eastern Australia, where there were permanent water supplies and better vegetation.”
大多數體型大型、主要以瀏覽植物為食的動物失去棲息地，退到 eastern Australia 的狹窄地帶；那裡有永久水源和較好的植被。
這些句子將 Australia megafauna 的壓力清楚連到 climate-driven water scarcity 和 habitat loss。
後文又說人類和 megafauna 共存很久，kangaroos 也能撐過長期 hunting。因此，若題目要求找climate change alone / primarily climate-driven case，Australia 是最直接答案。
所以 39 答案是 B — Australia。
Question 40 Multiple Choice Multiple Choice 題要找最完整、最精確受原文支持的選項；不能只因某個選項重現原文字就選。
Golden Manual 對 MCQ 的流程要求包括：拆題幹、Skim、Scan、Read、建立正確選項與原文的

questions.answer: C — Climatic change was not solely responsible for megafaunal extinction in Europe.
questions.answerKey: C — Climatic change was not solely responsible for megafaunal extinction in Europe.
questions.prompt: “Which statement is true according to the Stuart team’s findings?”
questions.translation: 根據 Stuart team 的 findings，哪個說法正確？

blocks.text: “The group of scientists led by A. J. Stuart focused on northern Eurasia—essentially Europe and Siberia—where the best data show that animals became extinct during the Late Pleistocene.”
A. J. Stuart 領導的科學家團隊聚焦 northern Eurasia，也就是 Europe and Siberia；那裡最佳數據顯示動物在 Late Pleistocene 期間滅絕。
“Extinction followed human predation, but only during periods of fundamental environmental change.”
滅絕跟隨人類捕食出現，但只在根本性環境變化時期發生。
題目明確提到 Stuart team，Paragraph G 第一行已出現 A. J. Stuart。因此這一段是目標段落。首尾句顯示答案一定與 northern Eurasia / Europe、human predation、environmental change 的關係有關。
原文中最關鍵的句子是：
“Nor was there a simple correspondence between these extinctions and either human arrival or climate change alone.”
“Instead, the evidence points to a combined effect…”
這兩句正好用來判斷 climate alone 是否足夠。
“Nor was there a simple correspondence between these extinctions and either human arrival or climate change alone.”
這些滅絕與 human arrival 或 climate change alone 之間，也沒有簡單的一一對應關係。

“Instead, the evidence points to a combined effect: a fundamental change in climate reorganised the vegetation, and this change, together with the presence of advanced Palaeolithic humans, caused the wave of extinction.”
證據指向 combined effect：根本性氣候變化重組了植被，而這種變化加上 advanced Palaeolithic humans 的存在，造成了滅絕浪潮。
“Climatic change was not solely responsible for megafaunal extinction in Europe.”
climatic change 並非 Europe megafaunal extinction 的唯一原因。
這正好對應原文 “climate change alone” 不足以解釋，以及 “combined effect” 的結論。Europe 在題目中對應 Paragraph G 的 northern Eurasia，因為原文明確說 northern Eurasia essentially includes Europe and Siberia。
選項排除A. Neanderthals rather than modern humans caused the extinction in Europe.原文說：
“Neither phase clearly coincided with the replacement of Neanderthals by modern humans.”
兩個滅絕階段都沒有清楚地與 Neanderthals 被 modern humans 取代的時間重合。
這句沒有支持 Neanderthals caused extinction。A 把原文中的 Neanderthals 轉成原因，關係錯了。
B. Palaeolithic humans in Europe alone killed large animals such as the giant deer.原文說的是 climate change 加上 advanced Palaeolithic humans 的 combined effect。B 加入

“alone”，方向過強，忽略 climate reorganised the vegetation。 D. Moderate and staggered extinction was mainly the result of fundamental climatic change.原文確實說 northern Eurasia 的 extinctions were moderate and staggered，也說 climate change fundamental。但 Stuart team 的重點是 combined effect，不是 mainly climate。D 只抓住一部分，沒有保留 human predation / human presence 的共同作用。所以 40 答案是 C。

paragraphOverview.title: 全文 Skim Roadmap
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: Paragraph A 首句介紹 Irish elk，也稱 giant deer，並說英俄科學家分析 ancient bones and teeth後發現牠存活到約 5,000 BC。尾句提出可能因素：hunting 或 habitat destruction by humans。只看首尾句，可以推測這段主要修正舊觀點：giant deer 並未如以往相信般早早滅絕，牠比預期多活了三千多年。段落功能是引出新研究和新解釋：除了 climate change，人類活動也可能加速最終滅絕。

Paragraph B 首句解釋 Irish elk 名稱來源，說牠的 remains 常在 Ireland peat bogs 下的 lake sediments 中保存良好，並交代牠約 400,000 years ago 首次出現在 Europe and Central Asia。尾句說其 range 後來縮小到 Ural Mountains。只看首尾句，這段大概處理分布史：giant deer 曾廣泛分布於歐洲和中亞，後來活動範圍收縮。重要定位詞包括 400,000 years ago、Europe、Central Asia、Ural Mountains。

Paragraph C 首句說 giant deer 最後在 western Siberia 生存，時間是 ice sheets receded 之後約3,000 年。尾句引用 Lister，說 climatic change 和 human pressures 合起來可能最終消滅牠們。只看首尾句，這段會解釋最後棲息地如何因森林擴張、乾旱、食物植物流失和人類壓力變得不適合生存。段落功能是把 extinction 放進 Ural / Siberia 的具體環境變化中。

Paragraph D 首句說 human hunting 常被提出為 Pleistocene megafauna extinction 的contributory cause。尾句說 human presence may help explain why Irish elk 無法撐過最新一輪climatic fluctuations，雖然牠過去曾挺過多次氣候變化。只看首尾句，這段會討論人類造成的額外壓力：不只是 hunting，也包括 Neolithic farmers settled and cleared the land。段落功能偏向補充human-made habitat destruction 這個重要原因。

Paragraph E 首句說 Lister 質疑另一種解釋：deer’s demise 可能由 male’s huge antlers 引起。尾句說 last glacial period 結束時，vegetation changed，可能不能提供足夠 minerals。只看首尾句，這段大概會討論 antlers theory：巨大鹿角可能在森林中不便，也需要大量 calcium and phosphate compounds。作者會比較支持和質疑這理論的證據，尤其是 deer 曾經在 wooded interglacials 中生存。

Paragraph F 首句把視野擴大到全球 megafauna，說世界各地大型動物滅絕到 last ice age 結束時幾乎完成。尾句提到 modern kangaroos 經歷 Aboriginal hunting 和 commercial shooters 仍能存活。只看首尾句，這段會比較不同地區：Africa、Asia、Australia 的氣候變化和人類狩獵影響。段落功能是說明 megafaunal extinction 不能用單一人類狩獵模型解釋，地區差異很重要。

Paragraph G 首句介紹 A. J. Stuart 團隊研究 northern Eurasia，即 Europe and Siberia，因為那裡有最佳數據。尾句說 extinction followed human predation, but only during periods of fundamental environmental change。只看首尾句，這段是全文總結性研究觀點：在 northern Eurasia，滅絕既沒有單純對應 human arrival，也沒有單純對應 climate change。更合理的解釋是climate-driven vegetation change 加上 Palaeolithic humans 的共同影響。
